sloka: तस्य तद्भाषितं श्रुत्वा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः ।तां कथां कथयामास वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः ।। ७.५७.३ ॥
transliteration: tasya tadbhāṣitaṁ śrutvā rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ ।tāṁ kathāṁ kathayāmāsa vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 7.57.3 ॥

translations.english: Having heard Lakshmana's words, Rama, whose valor is truth, then narrated the story of the great-souled Vasishtha.
